title: Surface-Water Storage Geometry & Compact State Readiness Contract

reference_equations.level_knots: STTAB(1,1)=100 cm; STTAB(2,1)=0; STTAB(i,1)=zbotdr(1+nrpri)*(i-2)/20 for i=3..22, preserving frozen multiply-then-divide operation order
reference_equations.storage_sum: for every knot and each secondary level ilev=1+nrpri..nrlevs with SWDTYP=2 and level>zbotdr(ilev), add open-channel cross-section volume divided by LSPACING(ilev)
reference_equations.forward_storage_from_level: piecewise-linear interpolation SWSTLEV over the 22 prepared knots
reference_equations.inverse_level_from_storage: piecewise-linear interpolation WLEVST over the same 22 prepared knots

source_risk_holds.rule: STTAB(22,1)=zbotdr*20/20.0d0 is mathematically the bottom but not guaranteed bit-identical to zbotdr
source_risk_holds.qualification_rule: characterize exact frozen behavior; do not silently snap the knot to zbotdr and do not add a configurable tolerance

SWST.classification: committed physical state only for SWSEC=2 simulated secondary surface water

WLS.classification: derived quantity for SWSEC=2; external forcing/control for SWSEC=1

modern_storage_parameterization.reference_mode: prepared immutable 22-knot level/storage relation equivalent to frozen STTAB semantics
modern_storage_parameterization.sharing: share prepared relation by parameter ID/reference across columns using identical surface-water geometry
modern_storage_parameterization.per_column_persistent_payload: only SWST when simulated secondary surface water is active

hard_holds: No drainage exchange law in F-PM08D1.
No supply/discharge or weir balance in F-PM08D1.
No runtime transaction composition implementation in F-PM08D1.
No file parsing or calendar logic in kernel/component code.
No production source modification in this readiness workunit.
No silent remediation of D1-RISK-01; exact-bottom behavior requires explicit child disposition.
readiness_exit: strict monotonic storage relation demonstrated over valid table domain
forward and inverse interpolation mutually consistent within floating arithmetic
endpoint and outside-domain behavior characterized including D1-RISK-01
MultiSWAP sharing and optional-state consequences explicit
